official: 東京都児童福祉施設の設備及び運営の基準に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 一部の児童福祉施設に性暴力防止策を義務付け
summary: 現在の条例には、児童への性暴力の防止に関する今回の規定はありません。この議案では、対象となる児童福祉施設の設置者に、児童と接する従事者の犯罪事実の確認などを義務付けます。施行日は2026年12月25日です。
changes: 対象施設の設置者に、児童への性暴力の防止と、被害を受けた児童の保護に必要な措置を義務付ける
支配性・継続性・閉鎖性のある環境で児童に接する従事者について、犯罪事実の確認を義務付ける
who: 対象となる児童福祉施設の設置者
対象施設で、規定に該当する環境で児童に接する従事者
対象施設を利用する児童
why: 関係する法律の施行に伴って児童福祉法などが改正され、児童への性暴力の防止などについて規定を設ける必要があるためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Requires some child welfare facilities to prevent sexual violence
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tokyo Metropolitan Ordinance on Standards for the Equipment and Operation of Child Welfare Facilities
en.summary: The current ordinance has no provisions of the kind proposed here on preventing sexual violence against children. This bill requires operators of the facilities covered to check the criminal records of workers who come into contact with children, among other measures. It takes effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Requires operators of covered facilities to take necessary measures to prevent sexual violence against children and protect children who have suffered harm
Requires criminal record checks for workers who come into contact with children in environments marked by power imbalance, ongoing contact, and lack of openness
who: Operators of covered child welfare facilities
Workers at covered facilities who come into contact with children in environments covered by the provisions
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says this is necessary because, with the relevant law taking effect, the Child Welfare Act and other laws were amended and provisions need to be established to prevent sexual violence against children and address related matters.
